title: 7 Things Proverbs Says a Real Friend Will Do to You
caption:
Faithful are the wounds of a friend (Proverbs 27:6). A real one risks the friendship to tell you the truth.

A nice friend agrees with you. A real one sharpens you, shows up uninvited, and calls your sin his business, not to control you, but because he can't watch you go under in silence.

Which one do you actually have?
